app.title: Back office
app.error: Something went wrong. Reload the page; if it stays, tell the support team.

login.title: Sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the shop code, username and password.
login.limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.

password.title: Choose a new password
password.help: Before you continue, replace the password you were given with your own.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.

passwordProblem.contains_username: Do not put your username in your password.

nav.themeNotSaved: Not saved for your other computers. It still applies here.

home.nothing: There is nothing here for your role yet.

staff.title: Staff
staff.help: Everyone who works in the shop. Give each person a role, a temporary PIN for the counter, and a back-office password only if they need one.
staff.name: Name
staff.saved: {{name}} has a temporary PIN. Tell them in person; they choose their own at the counter.
staff.weak_pin: Choose a harder PIN: 4 to 6 digits, not a run like 1234 and not one digit repeated.
staff.shortCodeField: Short code (optional, for unlocking a counter)
staff.rolesHelp: Each role gives a set of permissions. Templates follow the shop's job list.
staff.rolesSaved: Roles saved. Counters pick them up at their next sync.

password.title: Back-office password
password.none: {{name}} has no back-office password and can only unlock counters.
password.has: {{name}} can sign in to the back office.
password.temporaryHelp: Tell the person in person. They must replace it with their own at their first sign-in.
password.saved: {{name}} has a temporary password. Their open sessions were ended.
password.removeConfirm: {{name}} will be signed out and can no longer use the back office. Counters still work with their PIN.
password.optionalHelp: Leave empty for someone who only works at the counter. Otherwise a temporary one, at least 10 characters: they replace it at their first sign-in.

staff.deactivateConfirm: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and disappears from the counters at their next sync. Their bills and history stay.

errors.duplicate_username: Another person already has this username.
errors.duplicate_shortCode: Another person already has this short code.
errors.duplicate_email: Another person already has this email.
errors.cannot_grant: You can't give or take away a role with rights you don't have yourself.
errors.self: You can't do this to your own account.
errors.last_owner: The shop must keep at least one active Owner.
errors.weak_password: Choose a longer temporary password: at least 10 characters, without the username.
errors.pin_not_allowed: Only someone with at least this person's rights can give them a temporary PIN. Ask the owner.

staff.pinHelp: Give a temporary PIN to someone new or who forgot theirs. At their first unlock the counter makes them choose their own, and a new PIN also clears a lock on every counter at its next sync.
staff.reactivateConfirm: {{name}} can sign in again (if they have a password) and appears on the counters at their next sync.

counters.title: Counters
counters.help: To set up a counter PC, create a one-time code here and type it on that PC within the hour.
counters.name: Name (optional)
counters.revoked: {{code}} is revoked: it can no longer sync.
counters.confirmHelp: It stops syncing at once. Its unsynced bills stay on the PC: re-enable it here to let them sync. Bills it makes while revoked are flagged for review.
counters.confirmReenableHelp: It can sync again, and its waiting bills reach the server. Bills it made while revoked are flagged for review.
counters.reenabled: {{code}} is enabled again: its bills will sync.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics sent
diagnostics.help: A manager sends them from the counter (Alt+S, Send diagnostics). Kept 30 days.

shop.title: Shop and bill
shop.help: The shop's name and the lines printed at the top and bottom of every bill and desk slip. Counters print the change from their next sync; bills already printed stay as they were.
shop.policyHint: Printed at the bottom of the bill. Leave empty for the default.
shop.defaultPolicy: Exchange or return within 30 days with this bill.

problems.tooLong: At most {{max}} characters, to fit on one line of the bill.

shop.saved: Saved. Counters print it from their next sync.
shop.refused: Not saved: only the owner can change the shop's name and bill.
shop.failed: Not saved. Check the fields and try again.

reports.failed: The report could not be read. Try again; if it stays, tell the support team.

day.title: Day reconciliation
day.help: One business day of a branch: is it final, how each cash session closed, and every cash bill that never reached the drawer.
day.inTransit: Cash in transit at the day’s end
day.holds: Why the day isn’t final yet
day.noSessions: No cash session on this day.
day.deskSaid: the desk counted against {{amount}}: some documents haven’t arrived
day.noMissing: Every cash bill reached the drawer.

hold.day_not_over: The day isn’t over yet: it ends at {{time}}.
hold.device_not_heard: {{device}} hasn’t been heard from since the day ended (last: {{time}}).
hold.device_unsynced: {{device}} still has documents of the day to send (oldest {{time}}).

ack.own_variance: You can’t acknowledge the variance of your own session.
ack.nothing_to_acknowledge: There is no variance to acknowledge.
ack.forbidden: Your role can’t acknowledge a variance.

variance.title: Cash variance
variance.help: Every counted cash session in the dates, and each cashier’s total.
variance.none: No counted session in these dates.

register.title: Sales register
register.help: Every bill in the dates, returns and exchanges netted. A voided bill is listed struck through and left out of the totals.

ovr.title: Overrides
ovr.help: Every approval given at the counter: below list or floor, credit, returns, voids and reprints. The floor shows only with cost.

vr.title: Voids and returns
vr.help: Voids with their reasons and the bill issued in their place; returned lines by reason and condition.

stock.title: Stock and value
stock.help: What is on hand now at each location, valued at average cost. Values show only with cost.
stock.noCost_one: {{count}} item has no cost yet and counts 0.
stock.noCost_other: {{count}} items have no cost yet and count 0.
stock.truncated: Only the first 2,000 lines are shown; the totals count them all. Narrow the search.

ageing.title: Outstanding and ageing
ageing.help: Who owes the shop and whom the shop owes, by how long past the due date. Payments settle the oldest bills first.
ageing.differs: {{account}} is {{amount}}: the books and the ledgers differ. Tell support.

exc.title: Exceptions
exc.help: What the server flagged while accepting counter documents. A bill is never refused for it; review each one.

kinds.below_floor_no_override: Below the floor without an approval
kinds.document_inconsistent: A document's figures don't add up
kinds.handover_amount_mismatch: Cash at the desk doesn't match the bill
kinds.cash_received_for_void: Cash taken for a voided bill
kinds.cash_not_permitted: Cash taken by someone not allowed
kinds.return_original_invalid: Return of a bill that is not here
kinds.return_price_mismatch: Return price doesn't match the sale
kinds.refund_before_payment: Refund paid before the bill was paid
kinds.void_cash_duplicate: Cash given back twice for a voided bill
kinds.void_cash_not_voided: Cash given back for a bill that isn’t voided
kinds.void_cash_without_handover: Cash given back the desk never took
kinds.void_cash_amount_mismatch: Cash given back doesn’t match what was taken

home.title: Reports
home.help: Every report you may open. Each one filters by date, downloads as CSV and prints; a figure opens the lines behind it.

about.trialBalance: Every account's opening, movement and closing, debit and credit; it always balances.
about.profitLoss: Revenue, cost of goods sold, gross profit, expenses and net profit, against another period or month by month.
about.balanceSheet: What the shop owns and owes on a date, with this year's profit, against another date.
about.accountLedger: Every line of one account, with its opening and running balance: pick the account on Accounts.
about.cashBook: Each cash and bank account by day: opening, money in, money out, closing, and the documents.
about.dayBook: Every voucher posted in a period, with its lines.
about.expensesReport: Each expense account month by month, for up to a year.
about.salesRegister: Every bill of a day or range, with totals by salesman, counter and tender.
about.salesProfit: Sales, cost and gross profit by category, item, brand, salesman, customer, bill, day or month, against another period.
about.purchaseRegister: Every goods receipt and purchase return in a period, by supplier.
about.rates: For an item, a supplier or a customer: every purchase and sale with its rate, and the spread between them.
about.salesOverTime: The daily trend, the busy hours of the week, the top and bottom items, and the discounts given.
about.overridesReport: Prices below the list or the floor, and every other approval: who asked and who approved.
about.voidsReturns: Voided and reissued bills; returns by reason, condition, salesman and item.
about.stockReport: Stock on hand by location, and its value at average cost.
about.stockLedger: One item's documents in a period: the opening, each one in or out, the running balance and its value.
about.stockAt: On hand and its value on any date, by category and vehicle make.
about.stockMovement: Per item: opening, purchases, returns, sales, adjustments, transfers and closing, for a period.
about.reorder: Items at or below their minimum, with the quantity to order up to the maximum, by supplier.
about.deadStock: Stock that hasn't sold in a number of days, or would take more than 180 days to sell.
about.inventoryAnalysis: ABC by sales and by profit, stock turnover and days of cover.
about.ageing: What each customer owes and each supplier is owed, by how overdue it is.
about.dayReconciliation: One business day's cash: how each session closed and every bill not handed over.
about.cashVariance: Each cash session's variance over a range of days.
about.exceptions: What the counters and the server flagged for review.
about.trace: One bill from the counter to the books.
about.partnerLedger: One customer's or supplier's documents in a period, with the opening and running balance; print it as a statement.
about.statements: A statement for every customer with a balance or a document in the period, one to a page.
about.balanceTrend: Each customer's or supplier's balance today and 15 days, 1, 2, 3 and 6 months before.
about.overdue: Customers with bills unpaid more than a number of days past their due date.
about.overLimit: Customers over their credit limit or within 10% of it.
about.collections: Money received from customers and paid to suppliers, by how and by whom.
about.userActivity: Who did what: sign-ins, documents, edits and approvals.
about.cashFlow: Money in and out of cash and bank by what it was for, month by month.

frame.tooLong: That range is too long for this report. Lists take up to 92 days and summaries up to a year: narrow the dates.
frame.truncated: Only the first 1,000 lines are shown, but every total counts them all. Narrow the dates to see the rest.

tb.help: Each account's opening, movement and closing in the period. A group's row adds up the rows beneath it, so debits equal credits at every level. An account opens its ledger.

pl.help: What the shop earned and spent in the period. Cost of goods sold is at average cost; the panel below shows it from the stock and purchases. An account opens its ledger.

stock.title: Stock and purchases
stock.books: Cost of goods sold in the books

bs.help: What the shop owns and owes on a date. This year's profit is worked out from the books, not posted; profit of earlier years is in retained earnings. An amount opens its ledger.

cash.help: Every cash and bank account: the drawer, cash in transit, the safe, and the banks and wallets on Money. Money moved between two of them shows in both, marked as a transfer.

dayBook.help: Every voucher posted in the period, in the order it was posted, with its lines. A document number opens the document.

expenses.help: Each expense account month by month. An account opens its ledger for the whole period.

stockReports.truncated: Only the first 2,000 items are shown, but every subtotal and total counts them all, and the CSV has every row. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
stockReports.name: Name

at.help: How much of each item the shop had on a date and what it was worth in the books, grouped the way the shop counts. An item opens its stock ledger.

movement.help: What moved each item over a period: in is positive, out negative, so the opening plus every column is the closing. An item opens its stock ledger for the same period.

ledger.help: Every document that moved one item in a period, after its opening, with the running balance. A line opens its document.
ledger.pick: Pick an item by its code, name, OEM number or a scan.

kinds.costCorrection: Cost correction: sold before it arrived

reorder.help: Items whose stock in the Shop and the Godown is at or below their minimum, with the quantity that brings them up to the maximum, by supplier. Filter one supplier to print their list.

dead.help: Dead: in stock and not sold in the days chosen. Slow: sold, but at the last 90 days' rate it would take more than 180 days to sell. Items never sold since go-live count as dead only once those days have passed.

analysis.help: Class A items make the first 80% of sales (or of gross profit), B the next 15%, C the last 5%. Turnover is the cost of sales over the average stock value; days of cover is how long the stock lasts at the period's rate.

help.profit: What sold in the period, what it cost and the gross profit. Sales are what customers paid after every discount; cost is the average cost when it sold, as in the books. A return counts on its day for the salesman and customer of the bill it returns. A row opens the next level: a category its items, an item its bills, a bill its trace.
help.register: Every goods receipt and purchase return posted in the period, by supplier. Drafts are not purchases yet. A document opens it.
help.rates: Pick an item, a supplier or a customer (or an item and a party): every purchase with its rate on the supplier's bill and its net rate after discounts, every sale with its price and net rate, and for one item the spread between the average sale and purchase rates.
help.overTime: How sales moved day by day against another period, when the shop is busy, what sold most and least, and what discounts were given. Every chart has its figures in a table below it.

salesReports.truncated: Only the first 2,000 rows are shown, but every total counts them all. Narrow the filters or download the CSV to see the rest.

corrections.title: Cost corrections: stock sold before it arrived
corrections.help: Parts sold before the shop had them (borrowed, or not yet received) were costed at the average then, or at nothing if never bought. When the stock came in, the difference to what it really cost went to cost of goods sold here, in the period it came in. Each bill keeps the profit it showed on the day.

salesReports.beforeGoLive: The comparison starts before {{since}}, when the system began: it holds only what was sold since then.

rates.pick: Pick an item, a supplier or a customer to see their rates.
rates.manyItems: The averages and the spread are shown for one item: pick an item too.

overTime.discountsHelp: List price × quantity less what the customer paid: the line discounts and the bill discount together. A price above the list counts as a negative discount.

help.partnerLedger: Pick a customer or a supplier and a period: the balance before it, every document in it with its debit or credit and the running balance, the closing, and the closing balance by how overdue it is. 'As a statement' adds your shop's header and the customer's details for printing, and leaves out a voided bill and its void; 'With items' lists each bill's items.
help.statements: A statement for every customer with a balance at the end of the period or a document in it, one to a page: print them or save them as a PDF to send.
help.balanceTrend: Each party's balance as on a date and 15 days, 1, 2, 3 and 6 months before it, with the change in a month. A name opens the ledger.
help.overdue: Customers with bills unpaid more than the chosen number of days past their due date. Payments settle the oldest bills first, as in the ageing. A customer without terms owes each bill on its own day.
help.overLimit: Customers whose balance is over their credit limit, or within 10% of it. Customers without a limit are never listed.
help.collections: Every payment received from a customer (at a desk or into a bank) or paid to a supplier (from a bank, at a desk, or with the goods), with totals by how and by whom. Cash sales are in the sales register.
help.userActivity: Who did what in the period: sign-ins, the documents each person made, changes to items, prices, parties, users and settings with what changed, approvals, voids and locks. Passwords and PINs are never shown.
help.cashFlow: Cash and bank at the start, what came in and went out by what it was for, and cash and bank at the end; each month ends where the cash book does.

pick.customer: Pick a customer to see their ledger.
pick.supplier: Pick a supplier to see their ledger.

statement.ageing: The closing balance by how overdue it is

limits.noneSet: No customer has a credit limit yet. Set one on

activity.newest: Showing the newest {{shown}} of {{count}}; the CSV has every one.

flow.opening: Cash and bank at the start
flow.closing: Cash and bank at the end
flow.note: Money moved between the shop's own cash and bank accounts (handovers, deposits, the safe, transfers) is left out; a transfer's charges are an expense. A month's heading opens the cash book for it.

items.title: Items
items.help: Find an item by its code, name, brand, barcode or OEM number, as on the counter. Stock is what has posted: a counter's sales count once it syncs.
items.searchHint: Code, name words, barcode or OEM number
items.totalValue: Stock value of all matches (Shop and Godown)

item.ownFloorHint: Empty: cost + the category margin, else the list price

floorFrom.item: The counter's floor: {{floor}}, the item's own (cost + margin would be {{fromCost}}).
floorFrom.cost: The counter's floor: {{floor}}, cost + the category margin.
floorFrom.list: The counter's floor: {{floor}}, the list price (no cost yet).

newItem.title: New item
newItem.help: The item's code becomes its barcode, as on the legacy labels.
newItem.codeHint: Letters, digits and dashes, up to 20. It can't be changed later.
newItem.ownerPrices: The owner sets the prices after you save.

categories.title: Categories
categories.help: The floor margin: the counter's floor is the item's cost plus this much, unless the item has its own floor.
categories.saved: {{code}} saved. Its floors follow the new margin.

problems.code_format: A code has letters, digits and dashes only, up to 20.
problems.name_too_long: The name is too long (120 at most).
problems.qty_number: A quantity is not a number.
problems.min_above_max: The min is above the max.
problems.code_barcode_missing: The item's own code must stay as a barcode.
problems.tag_empty: Pick a make, or type a model or a year.
problems.year_range: The years are the wrong way round.
problems.price_number: A price is not a number.
problems.reason_unknown: Pick a reason from the list.
problems.reason_required: Say why a price goes down.
problems.floor_above_retail: The floor is above Retail: every sale at Retail will need a manager.

errors.stale: {{by}} changed this in the meantime. Reload to see it, then make your change again.
errors.code_taken: An item has this code already.

customers.title: Customers
customers.help: Customers the counters can pick with F4: their price tier, whether they buy on account, their limit and what they owe. A new customer reaches the counters within seconds.
customers.search: Search by code, name, phone or city
customers.added: {{name}} added. The counters have them within seconds.
customers.phoneUsed: This phone is already used by {{code}} {{name}}.
customers.termsLocked: Only the owner sets the price tier and credit terms. A new customer starts on the default tier, without credit.
customers.termsLockedEdit: Only the owner changes the price tier and credit terms.

fields.name: Name
fields.capHint: The most one counter sells them on account per day while offline.

customers.deactivateText: The counters and the desk stop showing them. Only a customer who owes nothing can be deactivated; to stop a customer who owes from buying on account, turn their credit off instead.
customers.reactivateText: The counters can pick them again.
customers.deleteText: Only for a customer added by mistake and never used.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.empty: Nothing on this customer's account yet.

problems.limit: Type the credit limit, or tick No limit.
problems.terms: Payment terms are whole days, 0 to 365.
problems.name: Type the customer's name.

errors.code_taken: That code is already used by another customer or supplier.
errors.phone_invalid: A phone number must have 7 to 15 digits.
errors.limit_required: Type the credit limit, or tick No limit.
errors.balance_open: This customer's balance is {{amount}}. Only a customer who owes nothing can be deactivated; turn their credit off instead.
errors.stale: {{by}} changed this customer in the meantime. Close and open it again.
errors.supplier_balance_open: The shop still owes this party {{amount}} as a supplier, so it stays active.
errors.in_use: This customer has been used, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.already_customer: This supplier is already a customer.
errors.forbidden: Only the owner sets the price tier and credit terms.
errors.invalid_request: Check the fields and try again.
errors.no_default_tier: The shop has no default price tier.

fields.name: Name
fields.billTotalHint: Posting waits until the lines add up to this

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.help: Who the shop buys from, and what it owes each of them.
suppliers.deactivateText: It is left out of the supplier lists on new receipts and returns. Its ledger and documents stay, and you can reactivate it at any time.
suppliers.reactivateText: It appears in the supplier lists on new receipts and returns again.
suppliers.deleteText: It has never been used, so it is removed from the lists for good.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.empty: Nothing on this supplier's account yet.

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.help: Supplier bills as they are printed: stock in, and what the shop owes.
receipts.editHelp: Type the bill as printed. Save keeps a draft; Post makes it final.
receipts.cashHint: Paid in cash? Post it on the supplier's account; the cashier then pays it at the desk (Pay supplier).

returns.title: Purchase returns
returns.help: Goods sent back to a supplier: stock out, and what the shop owes goes down.

line.searchHint: Code, name, barcode or OEM number

warnings.cost_up: The cost is more than 10 % above the last purchase.
warnings.cost_down: The cost is more than 10 % below the last purchase.
warnings.retail_at_or_below_cost: Retail is at or below this cost: the owner should reprice it.

problems.cost_invalid: The cost is not a valid amount.
problems.discount_invalid: The discount is more than the line.
problems.bill_discount_invalid: The bill discount is more than the lines.
problems.total_required: Type the bill total as printed.
problems.total_mismatch: The lines don't add up to the bill total.
problems.reason_unknown: Pick a reason from the list.
problems.more_than_received: More than the receipt still has.

errors.stale: {{by}} changed this in the meantime. Reload it, then make your change again.
errors.posted: It is posted and can't be changed.
errors.code_taken: A supplier or customer has this code already.
errors.in_use: It has been used (receipts, payments, its ledger or items), so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.posting_failed: It couldn't be posted ({{code}}). Nothing was changed.
errors.date_locked: The books are locked up to {{date}}. Pick a later date.
errors.date_in_future: The date can't be after {{today}}, the shop's business date.
errors.balance_open: The shop still owes this supplier {{amount}}. Settle it first, then deactivate.
errors.empty_draft: Add at least one item before saving.

labels.title: Print labels
labels.help: Labels for a posted goods receipt, one per piece, or for items picked on the items screen. Check the counts, then print on the label printer.
labels.printHint: In the print dialog choose the label printer, Margins: None and Scale: 100 %.
labels.empty: Type a goods receipt number, or pick items on the items screen.

problems.code_unprintable: This code can't be printed as a Code 39 barcode; it is left off.

warnings.supplier_abbr_missing: No supplier abbreviation: type one, or the label prints without it.

errors.not_posted: This goods receipt is not posted yet. Post it first, then print its labels.
errors.not_found: No goods receipt with that number.

template.title: Label template
template.description: One label on the roll, laid out as the legacy label. Every label printed follows it.
template.labelMakerBarcoded: Label items that already carry the maker's barcode
template.invalidNumber: Width, height and margin must be numbers.

problems.margin_out_of_range: The margin must be 0–5 mm and leave at least 10 mm of label.
problems.shop_abbr_too_long: The shop abbreviation can be at most 10 characters.

problems.from_required: Pick where the stock comes from.
problems.same_location: From and To are the same place.
problems.transit_location: Stock goes into and out of In transit only by sending and receiving.
problems.item_repeated: This item is on another line already.
problems.reason_unknown: Pick a reason from the list.
problems.write_off_not_damaged: A write-off is out of Damaged: transfer the goods there first.
problems.write_off_gain: A write-off takes stock out: type it below 0.

warnings.below_zero: More than it has now: it goes below 0. It still posts.

errors.stale: {{by}} changed this in the meantime. Reload it, then make your change again.
errors.posted: It is posted and can't be changed.
errors.in_transit: It has been sent. Receive it instead.
errors.awaiting_approval: It is waiting for the owner's approval.
errors.in_use: It records a shortfall on arrival, so it stays. Post it, or send it to the owner.
errors.posting_failed: It couldn't be posted ({{code}}). Nothing was changed.
errors.date_locked: The books are locked up to {{date}}. Pick a later date.
errors.date_in_future: The date can't be after {{today}}, the shop's business date.
errors.empty_draft: Add at least one item before saving.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.help: Stock moved between the Godown, the Shop and Damaged. The storekeeper types a transfer; the owner or the manager posts it.
transfers.receiveHint: Type what arrived on each line. Anything short is recorded as lost on the way.
transfers.needsReceiving: This route needs receiving: posting sends the goods, and they reach the other side when someone receives them.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.help: Stock found, lost or broken, with a reason, valued at the average cost and posted to the books.
adjustments.willWait: The loss is more than {{limit}}: it will wait for the owner's approval before it posts.
adjustments.awaiting: Waiting for the owner's approval (sent by {{name}})
adjustments.awaitingHelp: Stock and the books don't change until it is approved.

card.title: Stock card
card.help: Every movement of an item, newest first, with the balance at its location and in total.
card.costCorrection: Cost correction: sold before it arrived

needed.title: Transfer needed
needed.help: Items the Shop has sold below 0 while the Godown still has some.

settings.title: Stock settings
settings.limitHelp: A loss above this, posted by anyone but the owner, waits for the owner's approval.
settings.routesHelp: Tick a route when goods spend time on the way (sent, then received). Unticked routes move at once.

money.title: Money
money.help: Bank receipts, expenses, transfers, supplier payments and journal vouchers. The books are locked up to {{lockDate}}.

new.receiptHelp: A customer's payment into a bank account. Their balance drops at once, on the counters too.
new.expenseHelp: Paid from a bank or from the safe. An expense from the drawer is a cash-out at the desk.
new.transferHelp: Money between banks, wallets, card settlement and the safe. Charges go to their expense; the destination gets the rest.

document.reverseHelp: A journal voucher swaps every line of its posting. It is never edited; a reversal is final.

voucher.help: Debits must equal credits. Customers go on Accounts receivable lines, suppliers on Accounts payable. Stock, the drawer and cash in transit can't be used.

periods.title: Periods
periods.help: Months are worked out from the start of the fiscal year. Nothing is entered on or before the lock date ({{lockDate}}); counter bills dated then post on the next open day.
periods.lockHelp: Afterwards nothing can be entered on or before this date. What still looks open is listed below; it does not stop the lock.
periods.reopenTitle: Reopen: move the lock date back to {{date}}
periods.reopenHelp: Only the owner can reopen. Say why; it is kept with the change.

checklist.draft_transfers: Stock transfers not posted or not received: {{count}}
checklist.cash_in_transit: Cash in transit holds {{amount}} (bills not handed over)

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.help: Each account's balance (debits − credits) at a date; a heading adds up its accounts. Open an account for its ledger.
accounts.name: Name

ledger.help: Every line on this account, with its running balance.
ledger.truncated: Only the first 1,000 lines are shown. Narrow the dates.

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.help: What an expense is for, and the account it goes to. A new category reaches the cash desks by itself.
categories.dialogHelp: Each category goes to an expense account.

problems.date_in_future: The date can't be in the future.
problems.date_locked: That date is locked; pick a later one.
problems.before_original: A reversal can't be dated before what it reverses.
problems.paid_from_required: Say where it was paid from.
problems.from_required: Say where the money comes from.
problems.same_account: From and to can't be the same.
problems.charges_invalid: Charges must be 0 or more, and less than the amount.
problems.possible_duplicate: The same one looks recorded already on that date. Save anyway only if it really is a second one.
problems.lines_too_few: A voucher needs at least two lines.
problems.account_not_postable: That is a heading; pick an account under it.
problems.account_inactive: That account is no longer in use.
problems.account_kept: Stock, the drawer and cash in transit can't be used in a voucher.
problems.party_not_allowed: Only Accounts receivable and payable lines take a customer or supplier.
problems.not_month_end: Lock only to the last day of a month.
problems.unchanged: That is the lock date already.
problems.reopen_not_allowed: Only the owner can move the lock date back.
problems.parent_not_heading: New accounts go under a heading.

errors.stale: {{by}} changed this meanwhile. Open it again.
errors.posting_failed: It couldn't be posted ({{code}}). Nothing was saved.
errors.date_locked: The books are locked up to {{date}}. Pick a later date.
errors.has_balance: This account still has a balance.
errors.empty_draft: Enter at least one line before saving.

billDetails.title: Bill details
billDetails.help: One bill from the counter: its items, prices, discounts, payments and what happened to it. Read only.
billDetails.noCost: No cost yet: sold before it was received
billDetails.noCostNote_one: {{count}} line had no cost yet when sold. Its cost is settled when the stock is received, on Sales and gross profit's cost corrections.
billDetails.noCostNote_other: {{count}} lines had no cost yet when sold. Their cost is settled when the stock is received, on Sales and gross profit's cost corrections.
billDetails.journal: Posted to the books as journal {{number}}
billDetails.notPosted: Not posted to the books yet
billDetails.readOnly: Read only: a finalized bill is never changed. Corrections are a void and reissue, or a return, on the counter.

help.bills: Sales bills from the counters, newest first. A voided bill is listed, marked, and left out of the total. Open a bill to see its items.
help.returns: Returns and exchanges from the counters, newest first, with the bill they came from. Open one to see its items.
